slice.source: evidence/b2/plan.json session_split.sessions[0] (the pinned S3 plan, sha 62dc8593…)
slice.binding_note: informational for the machine, mandatory for the operator — see the slice condition

transport_accounting.formula: ceil(4 × expected_total / 1000) (D-s4), from the instrument's l6_schedule
transport_accounting.note: production computation (b2_runner session plan: l6_schedule.expected_frames + crc_budget) of board-origin expected frames including IDENT, CLOSE and TERM; excludes host reply frames and any retry / retransmission traffic

conditions: One B2 map-utility session only — session 1 of 2 of the pinned S3 plan: pairs 0–4 (--pair-first 0 --pair-count 5), 6012 records (2 baselines + 5 × 1202), all-self-reporting, under the frozen lifecycle-2 S3 inputs (manifest aec84514…, plan 62dc8593…, prediction a611b8e0…, preregistration v0.3 fa401221…, pin table 82a5f2fb…). Session 2 is not authorized by this pair.

The runner validates that the requested CLI slice belongs to the pinned plan, but does not bind this ruling's informational slice object. This authorization is valid only when the production preflight reports exactly pair_first/count = 0/5. Any other invocation is outside this ruling even if preflight accepts it.

Before execution: a fresh board power cycle; physically confirm board 17A6 and console TX/RX connected to J7, not the loopback short. The full production preflight with the default SEARCH profile must pass before board contact, and the slice it reports must be exactly the one above.

Use a valid principal-boundary record no older than six hours at preflight, for runner test, signer p3signer and the recorded key identity (R1–R5 all passed). A freshly regenerated passing record for the same principals/key may replace the record observed at issue; archive the record actually used.

Keep the frozen CRC/bad-frame budget (650 = ceil(4 × 162327 / 1000)), the deadline (9568.970947322621 s = 1.25 × 6012 × 3600 / 3016.3995578641097 + 600), forced controls, identity checks, audit policy and verdict rules unchanged. Existing rel-v4 in-session recovery remains permitted and remains accounted for by the existing ledger.

Stop on a preflight refusal, KEY_NOT_LOADED, PAGE_MISMATCH, a U-Boot banner, the deadline, or any other session stop condition. Preserve partial and complete evidence, both ruling archives and the actual boundary record. No automatic restart, second session, new seed or renewed ruling is authorized by this pair; a LOST session is re-run only for the same pairs and seeds under a NEW ruling pair, never with other seeds.

No adjudication of the primary, no S-stage transition and no other session is authorized by this pair; report the session's evidence for review. The primary is pooled over both sessions' pairs (the one-sided exact sign test, α = 0.05) and is adjudicated only after both sessions are archived.
The lifecycle-1 manifests, its B2Q PASS and its measured rate are not inputs to this session (preregistration §8a).

transport_stop_loss_decision.decision: One explicitly authorized B2 session as a bounded exception to the standing transport stop-loss; no general release.
transport_stop_loss_decision.basis: The owner elects this session after the lifecycle-2 chain S0→S1→B2Q PASS→S2→S3 with a clean-tree proof at every stage (final: test_report_2026-09-16T210313Z.json). Byte deletions on the UART transport remain observed and their cause unresolved; 162,327 board-origin expected frames (production computation, excluding host replies and retries) is a long single transport exposure (the lifecycle-2 B2Q session was 543 board-origin expected frames for 20 records under the same production computation), and nothing here establishes transport stability.
transport_stop_loss_decision.preserved: No acceptance-contract change; no increase beyond the frozen formula-derived CRC and bad-frame budget: 650, computed as ceil(4 × expected_total / 1000); no exclusion of recovered CRC events from the existing ledger; no erasure of prior LOST attempts.
transport_stop_loss_decision.after_attempt: The exception is spent after this session, whatever its outcome. Any HOLD, KILL, LOST, PROTOCOL or other non-COMPLETED outcome is archived as observed and requires owner review before any further attempt. Two sessions lost to the same cause stop the line (preregistration §6 stop-loss).

boundary_record_observed_at_issue.note: An earlier scratchpad attempt while the pod was detached was NOT ESTABLISHED and is not used. This binding names the committed passing record above (commit 92d5051). If this pair is issued after the six-hour mark, a fresh passing record replaces this block at issue.

l6.crc_formula: ceil(4 x expected_total / 1000) (D-s4), from the instrument's l6_schedule
l6.deadline_formula: 1.25 x records x 3600 / rate + 600 (the instrument's l6_schedule.session_timeout_s)

deadline_rate.source: the plan's split, from the B2Q calibration
